units.source_text: 《古诗十九首》第一首云：“行行重行行，与君生别离。

en.t: The first poem in Nineteen Old Poems says: "On and on I go, farther and farther away, parted from you while we are both still alive.

units.source_text: 相去万余里，各在天一涯。

en.t: We are separated by more than ten thousand li, each of us at a different edge of the sky.

units.source_text: 道路阻且长，会面安可知？

en.t: The road is difficult and long; how can we know whether we will ever meet again?

units.source_text: 胡马依北风，越鸟巢南枝。……”

en.t: The northern horse turns toward the north wind, and the Yue bird nests on the southern branch..."
This means that even horses and birds long for their homeland.
